summary: Frontend-only verification of the VIN overflow fix in the 'Decoded from disc' card on the Submit screen. Tested at BOTH 320x700 (smallest common) and 390x844 (iPhone 12/13/14) viewports with the real MINI license-disc string and a synthesized worst-case all-wide 17-char VIN. All full-width fields (VIN, Engine No, Description, Expires, Disc No) render on their own full-width rows within the card border. VIN's mono value renders at fontSize 12px and fits precisely inside the card (VIN right edge = card right edge at both viewports, no scrollWidth > clientWidth overflow). 2-column fields (Licence No/Register No, Make/Model) pair correctly. Colour auto-fill, clear button, root-refresh regression, luxury black+cyan theme (rgb(0,229,255) verified on SIGN IN button and FB-ref IDs), and admin submissions list all still work.

critical_code_review_comments: DiskField `full` variant correctly applies flexBasis:100% + minWidth:100% + width:100% — this triple-override forces the item onto its own row even against the parent flexWrap+flexGrow+minWidth:45% grid. Verified visually and via getBoundingClientRect().

diskFieldValueMono at fontSize:12, letterSpacing:0, weight:600 with monospace family renders 17-char VIN 'WMW72DH0602R05896' at exactly 216px width inside a 216px content area at 320x700 — pixel-perfect fit.

numberOfLines={1} + adjustsFontSizeToFit + minimumFontScale=0.6 + ellipsizeMode='middle' provide defensive fallback for extra-wide values — verified with synthesized worst-case VIN 'WMWMMWDDHHHRR8596' (all wide uppercase chars, still 17); still rendered without overflow at fontSize=12px.
Card border and inner content boundaries are aligned — VIN row R=268 vs card R=268 at 320px, VIN R=338 vs card R=338 at 390px. Zero horizontal spillover.

Any future changes to grid math (styles.diskGrid, styles.diskField.minWidth/flexGrow) must be re-tested at 320x700 to ensure the full-width override still wins. Both viewport screenshots saved at /tmp/normal_320_recheck.png, /tmp/worst_320.png, /tmp/worst_390.png. Login as dealer minitest@example.com / Mini1234! and admin admin@fourbuy.co.za / admin123. Cyan theme color = rgb(0,229,255).
rca_of_issue: Verified fix (no bug remaining). Original overflow: DiskField with `full` only applied width:100%, which does NOT override flexBasis when parent uses flexWrap + flexGrow:1 + minWidth:45% — the item stayed in a ~45% wide grid cell and the 17-char monospace VIN overflowed. New fix applies flexBasis:100% + minWidth:100% + width:100% to break the row, plus reduced mono font to 12px with letterSpacing:0 and adjustsFontSizeToFit fallback. Confirmed via getBoundingClientRect() at 320x700 and 390x844.
